Intricate Teardrop Mandala 06 Coloring Page

A free printable intricate mandala with 18-fold symmetry and about 540 spaces to color.

Download and print

PDF, US LetterPDF, A4

Print at 100 percent scale. The lines print about 0.4 mm wide, best with fine-tip markers, gel pens or sharp colored pencils.

What's in it

From the center out: 18 double-lined teardrops, 36 teardrops, 36 dots, 18 double-lined diamonds, 18 triple-lined teardrops, a scalloped band, 36 double-lined teardrops, 36 dots, 18 triple-lined teardrops, 18 triple-lined hearts and 18 dots, inside a plain outer ring.

Change it first

Open it in the maker to change the symmetry, thicken the lines or add your own drawing.
